name: Chou Kagaku Dasshutsu Gear Detective
original_name: 超科学脱出 ギア・ディテクティブ
source:
The story follows Detective Kyosuke Ayana, who has the ability named chronokinesis which allows him to look back in time in a limited field of view, for up till 5 days back. Detective Ayana is hired to find a serial killer threatening the quiet neighborhood of Camellia Hills - but soon finds himself in much bigger trouble as he investigates the crime scenes.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/parascientific-escape-gear-detective-3ds]Nintendo[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述侦探绫奈恭介，他拥有一种名为“时空运转”的能力，可以让他在有限的视野内回顾过去，最多可追溯至5天前。阿亚娜侦探受雇寻找一名威胁茶花山安静社区的连环杀手，但在调查犯罪现场时很快发现自己遇到了更大的麻烦。

[来自[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/parascientific-escape-gear-detective-3ds]任天堂[/url]]
